body: I would be very pragmatic here and just copy/paste the changes you made to Monolog for 2.7 (as a bug fix). And then, another PR to bump the min value and use the regex from Monolog in master.

issue.body:
See #22264

| Bug fix?      | no
| New feature?  | no
| BC breaks?    | no

Bump monolog and use const from parent. See https://github.com/symfony/symfony/issues/22264#issuecomment-291524038

I went for `static` instead of `self` in case anyone wanted to easily override just the agent string.
